instruction: In an otherwise empty environment, set HOME to /tmp and PATH to /usr/bin, then print HOME.
context: env: --ignore-environment starts empty; assignments precede the exact command and its operand.

instruction: Remove DEBUG from the environment, change to /srv/app, and run ./worker with --once.
context: env: --unset removes one variable and --chdir changes directory before the exact command is invoked.

instruction: Wait at most five seconds for an exclusive lock on /tmp/deploy.lock, then run ./deploy staging.
context: flock: --exclusive selects an exclusive lock and --timeout takes seconds before lock file and command operands.

instruction: Without waiting, take a shared lock on /tmp/index.lock and print index.db with cat.
context: flock: --shared selects a shared lock and --nonblock fails immediately instead of waiting.

instruction: Run ./worker --once on CPUs 0 and 2 through 3 using CPU-list syntax.
context: taskset: --cpu-list accepts a comma/range CPU list before the exact command and arguments.

instruction: Set CPU affinity for every thread of process 4242 to CPUs 1 through 3 using list syntax.
context: taskset: --all-tasks covers every thread, --pid selects an existing process, and --cpu-list parses ranges.

instruction: Convert the IEC value 4K to SI output and append B.
context: numfmt: --from and --to select unit systems; --suffix appends the exact output suffix.

instruction: Format 1048576 using IEC-i units right-aligned in a twelve-character field.
context: numfmt: --to=iec-i selects binary units with i suffix and positive --padding right-aligns output.

instruction: Dump the first thirty-two bytes of firmware.bin as one-byte hex values with hexadecimal offsets.
context: od: --address-radix controls offsets, --format=x1 selects one-byte hex units, and --read-bytes limits input.

instruction: Skip 128 bytes of packet.bin, then show the next sixty-four bytes as named characters without offsets.
context: od: radix n suppresses offsets, format c names characters, and skip/read options bind byte counts.

instruction: Paginate report.txt in three columns with the header Quarterly Report.
context: pr: --columns takes the column count and --header takes the exact page header.

instruction: Paginate draft.txt with numbered, double-spaced lines and fifty lines per page.
context: pr: --double-space, --number-lines, and --length independently control requested page formatting.

instruction: Set report.csv timestamp to 2026-08-20 09:30 UTC but do not create the file if absent.
context: touch: --no-create refuses a missing file and --date parses the exact requested timestamp.

instruction: Give destination.txt the same timestamps as source.txt.
context: touch: --reference reads timestamps from its option value and applies them to the destination operand.

instruction: Print integers seven through twelve padded to equal width.
context: seq: --equal-width pads numbers; the two operands are the exact first and last values.

instruction: Print item-001 through item-005 separated by commas.
context: seq: --format controls each number and --separator replaces newlines between exact range endpoints.

instruction: Display the scheduling policy and priority of process 4242.
context: chrt: --pid with no policy or priority displays scheduling attributes of the existing process.

instruction: Run ./worker --once with round-robin scheduling at priority twenty.
context: chrt: --rr selects SCHED_RR; priority precedes the exact command and argument.

instruction: Set process 4242 to absolute nice value ten.
context: renice: --priority sets an absolute nice value and --pid identifies process IDs.

instruction: Set every process in process group 900 to absolute nice value five.
context: renice: --priority sets the absolute value and --pgrp interprets the following operand as a process group.
